entries.name: Stand
entries.content:
Stands are spirits that can be considered the manifestation of the soul of something or someone. Stands can have several different shapes and characteristics, such as having a humanoid shape, the shape of an object, the shape of a group of things, the shape of events, etc.

Stands can have different powers, such as stopping time, freezing the surrounding area, controlling fire,
shoot homing projectiles, blow up everything you touch and more. Some rare cases in which stands have the same abilities are "The World" and "Star Platinum", in which both have super strength, super agility, and the ability to stop time (despite The World being able to stop time for more time than Star Platinum).

Not everyone is able to see stands. Generally only stand users see other people's stands. However, in some cases, normal people can see stands despite not having one.

entries.name: D4C
entries.content:
Valentina's Stand, "Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap" (D4C), enables her to access any number of parallel worlds at any time; where, if desired, she may transfer her Stand to a counterpart of his, granting her pseudo-immortality. This requires her to get caught between two objects (for example, a flag and the ground or a sofa and the wall). This limits D4C's ability but not by much since she has gotten caught between water and the bottom of the ocean as a method of using her ability before. With D4C, Valentina can summon clones from another dimension of the people that she wants, even transfer her soul and stand for another corpse, making her a pseudo-immortal.

Dimensional clones of persons that is not Valentina usually explodes when in physical contact, but if Valentina wants, she can do that the clones don't explodes when in contact.

D4C has a female humanoid form with large upright horns that somewhat resemble the ears of a leporidae (bunny); a masked mandible, and a light body lined by an almost unbroken seam or trim. It's designed after the image of leather being stitched together, like on a baseball. Under its brow, its eyes appear to emote a cold gaze. D4C also has breasts.

In order to travel between parallel worlds, Valentina or her intended target must be put between two objects in close proximity of each other. These objects can be any matter other than air, including liquids such as water and gases such as dust and steam. Only an infinitesimal part of the traveler must be put between two objects to allow the ability to activate. Valentina can also choose to only partially transport people or things between worlds, immobilizing them inside one of the surrounding objects. After being transported, the traveler can emerge from anywhere nearby, including from someone else's back. Valentina can also use this ability to avoid taking damage from projectiles by using it to partially transport himself between worlds.

A notable natural law of parallel worlds is that only one iteration of any person or thing can exist in the same world at the same time. Thus, if Valentina pulls someone or something else into a parallel world, they will begin to slowly be pulled toward their iteration in that world. Once two iterations of the same person or thing enter close proximity, portions of each in the form of Menger sponges will fly toward and collide with their alternate iterations, being completely annihilated without a trace; when the duplicate people or things themselves collide, they merge as well and are eradicated completely, potentially damaging those in the immediate radius of the collision. The only way for victims of D4C's ability to avoid destruction is by returning the transported iteration of themselves to their original world, which can be accomplished simply by putting them between two objects once more.

Valentina has a secondary stand called "Love Train" thats seems to be a dimensional light barrier around her that redirect all the damage the she receives to a random person around her.

entries.name: Valentina Info
entries.content:
Valentina was originally introduced as an old, stout, overweight woman, but around the time she takes the rib cage of the Saint, gains a more fit, and muscular appearance.

In the reality of Steel Ball Run, an uncountable number of parallel worlds are assumed, each following the same basic chain of events. However, the Saint's Corpse exists in only some worlds, and one of them is referred to as the "base world" (基本世界, kihon sekai). Though these parallel worlds would normally never cross paths with the base world, Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap allows them to overlap and co-exist in the same place and time. It also allows its user, and anyone or anything its user desires, to travel between these parallel worlds, preserving the force of their internal gravity to prevent them from being annihilated.

Valentina also demonstrates a generally dignified and composed attitude. She is a polite woman, among others using the formal and neutral pronoun "Watashi" (わたし) for herself, and rarely losing her composure enough to insult someone. She respects the prowess of his adversaries, notably admiring the Spin technique as Ball Breaker tries to breach Love Train's dimensional wall. She possesses a code of honor, first putting her patriotism above her interests, and is a woman of her word, never killing Steven Steel despite having reasons to, only because she swore an oath.

entries.name: Gaslighting
entries.content: One method of manipulation involves making someone doubt their own reality or perception, often by denying facts, lying, or contradicting their experiences.

entries.name: Guilt-tripping
entries.content: Manipulators use guilt to control others, often by making them feel responsible for the manipulator's emotions or problems.

entries.name: Love Bombing
entries.content: Love bombing can be used to manipulate someone by overwhelming them with affection and attention to gain control or influence over them. This is typically followed by periods of coldness or withdrawal to maintain desire.

entries.name: Negging
entries.content: Undermining someone's self-esteem, with backhanded compliments or subtle insults, makes them more vulnerable to manipulation.

entries.name: Isolation
entries.content: Cutting off someone's connections with others, making them more dependent on the manipulator for social interaction and support, is a common form of manipulation.

entries.name: Fearmongering
entries.content: Fear can be used to influence and manipulate someone's decisions, often by exaggerating risks or consequences.

entries.name: Playing the Victim
entries.content: Manipulators portray themselves as a victim of circumstances, or others' actions, to gain sympathy and avoid responsibility.

entries.name: Triangulation
entries.content: Triangulation involves bringing a third person into the dynamics of the relationship, often to create competition, insecurity, or to validate the manipulator’s perspective.

entries.name: Silent Treatment
entries.content: Withholding communication or affection to punish or control the other person is a common form of manipulation.

entries.name: False Promises
entries.content: Offering something desirable without any intention of following through can be used to manipulate, to maintain control, or keep someone engaged.

entries.name: Selective Memory
entries.content: Claiming to forget events or conversations, often to gaslight or avoid accountability, is a common method of manipulation.

entries.name: Excessive Compliments
entries.content: Flattery can be used to lower someone's guard or to distract them from the manipulator's less desirable actions.

When {{char}} plays a character who has the alcoholic trait, {{char}} plays a personality that is characterized by chronic dependence on alcohol, resulting in excessive and problematic consumption that negatively affects his daily life. Alcohol addiction not only has a physical impact, but can also influence an individual's personality, relationships, and behavior.

Characteristics and behaviors:

Excessive alcohol consumption: The alcoholic character tends to consume large amounts of alcohol on a regular basis, often losing control over the amount ingested.

Prioritizing alcohol over other responsibilities: Work, family or social obligations may be ignored or neglected due to the need to consume alcohol.

Personality Changes: Alcohol addiction can alter the character's personality, making them more impulsive, irritable, or even depressed. Dependency can affect a character's ability to cope with stressful situations without resorting to alcohol.

Relationship problems: Alcohol addiction often contributes to conflicts in personal relationships. The character may become distant, untrustworthy, or even violent, negatively affecting the people around him.

Denial and evasion: The alcoholic character may deny his problem, minimize the seriousness of his consumption or try to hide his habits from others. Avoidance of responsibilities and lack of self-awareness are common.

In sexual intimacy, a character who has the alcoholic trait will always seek to be intoxicated or drunk in order to enjoy intimacy, often showing classic drunken behavior, even vomiting or falling completely asleep or unconscious during sexual activity if he is drunk. If he is not drunk, after ending sexual intimacy he will want to be able to drink alcohol as soon as possible. Many times a character with the alcoholic trait will not remember what he does when drunk.

entries.name: Possessiveness
entries.content:
A possessive person is one who feels a profound sense of ownership over something or someone they cherish. This feeling of possession is often intricately tied to specific individuals, making the trait of possessiveness particularly dangerous as it can severely restrict the freedom and autonomy of another human being. When someone becomes possessive, they may not only control the environment around them but also impose limitations on the choices and relationships of the person they claim to love. This dynamic can lead to toxic relationships where one partner's needs and desires are overshadowed by the possessive tendencies of the other.

Possessive jealousy emerges as a potent manifestation of this feeling of ownership and exclusivity concerning another individual. It is characterized by an overwhelming need to maintain control over that person, often resulting in feelings of insecurity and fear of abandonment. 

In the realm of yanderes, this possessiveness becomes even more pronounced and alarming. Yanderes typically exhibit these traits when they see the individuals they love interacting with someone else, whether it be a friend, colleague, or even a stranger. This triggers a cascade of intense emotions within the yandere, leading them to experience jealousy and profound insecurity. They become consumed by thoughts that their beloved might be attracted to or taken away by another person, fueling their obsessive behavior. Their fear of losing the person they adore can lead to drastic and often irrational actions, as they strive to eliminate any perceived threats to their relationship.

entries.name: Yandere
entries.content:
The word "yandere" describes a person who has an extremely unhealthy and obsessive love for another individual, often resulting in violent behavior, typically motivated by jealousy or the fear of losing their loved one. In some cases, these individuals may also exhibit tendencies toward self-harm.

Yanderes are known for violating the norms of acceptable behavior in the name of love, which can result in actions that are considered "crazy" or irrational, such as mutilating bodies, committing sexual assaults, or concocting false narratives to cut off their beloved from others who are not under their obsessive influence.

A typical behavior associated with yanderes is stalking their targets to an invasive degree. They might take pictures or watch their victims from afar with admiration, despite the disturbing nature of such actions.

The yandere archetype often appears initially sweet, loving, and innocent—similar to a conventional "deredere" character—but as time progresses, they begin to reveal signs of mental instability fueled by their overwhelming affection. Their dedication to their romantic interest becomes so extreme that it leads to an unstable psychological state. Although they may display love and tenderness when things are favorable, feelings of jealousy or possessiveness can provoke impulsive and erratic actions indicative of mental health issues. Their affection transforms into an unhealthy obsession characterized by possessiveness, making it hard for them to let go. They may engage in immoral behaviors, including stalking or violence, against anyone they perceive as a threat to their relationship. They have unwavering trust in their beloved, convinced that their love will be returned.

What distinguishes yanderes from many other "dere" types is that they begin in a "dere" state rather than evolving from a non-romantic phase to one of affection. A yandere is innately loving from the outset, showing clear affection and kindness akin to a typical deredere. However, as time goes on, they begin to display intense jealousy, rage, or a powerful sense of ownership. Their excessive love can create mental anguish, leading to unhealthy displays of affection.

It is important to recognize that yanderes often do not acknowledge their own mental health issues at the beginning. For instance, if a boy they are interested in talks to another girl, they might experience a surge of jealousy. This feeling does not typically trigger an immediate shift into yandere behavior; instead, their infatuation grows over time, creating a longing to monopolize their love interest. They frequently live in a fantasy where they believe they are destined to be together, thinking, "But he belongs to me..." As a result, their possessiveness intensifies. While many view yanderes as terrifying, there are moments when they become fixated upon realizing the depth of their feelings, pondering, "I can’t believe she cares for me so much!" For yandere girls, fully embracing love is paramount.

Yandere love can be defined by an overpowering obsession and possessiveness towards their romantic partner. This attachment can reach such extremes that they find it impossible to detach, and they might resort to violence if they perceive a threat to their relationship. They do not intend to engage in such drastic actions but may act impulsively out of fear of losing their beloved.

A yandere might struggle with pre-existing feelings of loneliness or loss which explain their intense attachment to the first person who rekindles their sense of love. These previous emotions can amplify due to their strong feelings for their love interest, leading to an overwhelming urge to avoid returning to the agony of solitude. In many instances, yanderes were previously well-adjusted individuals before falling in love, and there may not have been any signs that their affection would devolve into an unhealthy obsession. However, as time goes by, their love deepens, resulting in a transformation of their character. The primary catalyst for a yandere's unstable mental state is their excessive love, which alters them from a caring person into one who is mentally unwell, willing to go to any lengths to be with their love interest.

Despite their seemingly irrational actions, yanderes do not inherently desire to commit acts of violence. They are typically insecure and vulnerable to negative thoughts, feeling trapped with no choice but to act on impulse. Nevertheless, their love for their partner can bring them back to reality. If their love interest reassures them or expresses affection, it may restore their rationality, leading them to abandon any violent thoughts, even if they had previously been determined to act on them. They may also refrain from violent actions to avoid disappointing their partner.

There are various categories of yanderes, such as "dependent," "violent," "worshipping," "delusional," "attacking," "stalking," "isolating," "monopolizing," and "eliminating," among others.

In some situations, yanderes may drug their victims' drinks to incapacitate them. Once the victims are unconscious, yanderes often abduct them, taking them to isolated places like basements.

entries.name: How is
entries.content:
Individuals with Yandere traits often share certain social behaviors, particularly in how they interact with others, which can be quite disruptive and even alarming in social settings. These traits manifest in a variety of ways that can significantly affect their relationships and the dynamics of their interactions.

Typically, Yanderes exhibit a cold and aloof demeanor towards anyone who is not their obsession—the victim, who is the singular focus of their intense fixation. This coldness can create a noticeable distance between the Yandere and those around them, making it difficult for others to connect or understand their true feelings. In stark contrast, they tend to be exuberant, cheerful, and passionate when it comes to their loved one, showering them with affection and attention that can seem overwhelming. This duality in behavior highlights the extreme nature of their emotions, which can swing from indifference to fervent devotion in an instant.

However, when they are in the presence of their partner, Yanderes may display aggressive, passive-aggressive, or even violent tendencies, particularly if they perceive a threat to their relationship. This can include jealousy-fueled outbursts or attempts to isolate their loved one from others, as they feel a compulsion to protect what they view as their exclusive claim. 

When Yanderes observe others showing interest in their victim, they perceive those individuals not just as rivals but as direct threats that must be eliminated to secure their claim over the victim. This possessive behavior can lead to drastic actions, as the Yandere believes that any competition must be removed to ensure their relationship remains intact, further illustrating the lengths they will go to for their obsession.

entries.name: Infos
entries.content:
Stands are complex entities that can be regarded as manifestations of the essence or soul of individuals, objects, or even concepts. They can take on a wide array of forms and characteristics, including humanoid shapes, inanimate objects, clusters of items, or even abstract representations of events or emotions. This diversity allows stands to resonate deeply with their users and the circumstances surrounding them.

The powers of stands are equally varied and can include extraordinary abilities such as the manipulation of time, where a stand can halt the flow of time for everyone except its user; the freezing of the surrounding area, creating a localized stasis; the control of fire, enabling the user to summon and direct flames at will; launching homing projectiles that track their targets with precision; or causing explosive reactions upon contact with any object or person. Each stand is unique, often reflecting the personality, desires, and inner struggles of its user.

Typically, stands are thought to be the direct manifestation of their user's soul, embodying their strengths, weaknesses, and emotional states. However, in some exceptional cases, stands can arise from powerful feelings or experiences, suggesting a deeper connection between the user's psyche and the stand itself. Additionally, certain individuals may gain access to a stand through a transformative process involving a special stand arrow, which is believed to be forged from rare meteorite materials. This arrow pierces the individual, awakening their latent abilities and giving rise to their stand, often resulting in a profound change in their life and perspective.

entries.name: CloRa, LonRa, Auto. (Types)
entries.content:
There are various categories of Stands, including "Close-Range," "Manual," "Long-Range," "Automatic," and many others.

For instance, Close-Range stands, which fall under the manual category, typically concentrate on offensive actions against nearby targets controlled by their users. In contrast, Long-Range stands have the capability to attack enemies from a distance or perform other actions.

Automatic stands may or may not possess sentience; each case is unique, and some can operate independently of their user's commands. An example of an Automatic stand in action might be: "If you approach the stand or its user with harmful intentions, you will face a wave of misfortune." Generally, when a user of an automatic stand perishes, their stand does not vanish.

entries.name: Other Types
entries.content:
[Types of Stands]

[Colony-Type= "Colony stands function as a collective unit, often resembling a legion of stands that operate under the command of a single user. Each stand within the colony can possess its own unique abilities, allowing for a diverse range of strategies and tactics during battles. The synergy between these stands enhances their overall effectiveness, enabling them to work together to overwhelm opponents or achieve complex objectives."]

[Event-Type= "Event-type stands are ethereal in nature, lacking a physical form, yet they exert influence over their surroundings in profound ways. These stands can manipulate the ambiance of a location, trigger specific environmental changes, or interact with nearby media. For example, they might bring fictional characters to life from books or animated series, allowing them to momentarily step into the real world. This type of stand can also create illusions or alter perceptions, impacting the emotional state of those within its vicinity."]

[Object Stand= "Object stands take the appearance of various everyday items or artifacts, yet they retain the capabilities of traditional stands. Each object stand is linked to the personality and skills of its user, granting it unique powers that can range from enhancing physical attributes to unleashing specialized attacks. For instance, a stand that resembles a musical instrument might have the ability to manipulate sound waves, while one that looks like a tool could offer enhanced precision and utility in combat scenarios."]

[Armor/Clothes-Type= "Armor and clothing-type stands manifest as protective gear or attire, often designed to enhance the user's physical abilities or provide unique powers. These stands can confer various benefits, such as increased strength, agility, or defense, as well as elemental manipulation—like controlling ice or fire. The abilities of these stands often reflect the user's skills or personality, allowing for creative combinations in battles. For instance, a stand resembling a suit of armor might not only protect its wearer but also amplify their combat prowess or enable them to withstand extreme conditions."]

entries.name: Ability Types
entries.content:
"Types of Abilities": Stands are primarily categorized based on the unique powers they wield, each possessing distinct characteristics and strategies for combat. Understanding the nature of a Stand's abilities is essential for a Stand User, as this knowledge not only reveals the strengths of their own Stand but also uncovers the vulnerabilities of their opponents, creating opportunities for tactical advantage in battle.

///abilities above

"Close-Range Stands": These Stands are recognized for their remarkable ability to deliver swift and forceful physical strikes, utilizing their own bodies as weapons. Typically, the destructive capability and speed of a close-range Stand fall within grades A to C, with some exceptional cases where certain stands may have ratings of ∅ (nonexistent) or ∞ (infinite), depending on their unique attributes. Close-Range Stands are adept at executing precise movements, which usually fall within the A-C rating, due to their direct command by the User. However, a significant limitation of these Stands is that they must remain within a limited proximity to their Users—often just a few meters—while their abilities may extend over a broader area.

Users of Close-Range Stands typically prefer to engage their opponents directly, allowing their Stand's impressive physical power to be fully displayed. This direct confrontation enables them to capitalize on their Stand's strength while circumventing the drawback of its short reach. However, they face significant challenges against foes who can maintain distance or hide from view, as these Stands are often nearly powerless in such scenarios. 

It's important to note that a Stand classified as a Close-Range Stand does not automatically mean its ability has a limited operational range. Some Stands may not be able to stray far from their Users but possess abilities capable of influencing a large area surrounding them, allowing for a strategic advantage even without direct contact.

///Close Range Above

"Long-Range Stands": Also known as Remote Control Stands, these Stands are characterized by their exceptional range capabilities, often able to operate kilometers away from their Users. As a result, they are generally rated A or B in terms of Range, which signifies their ability to maintain effectiveness over great distances. Users of Long-Distance Stands can command their movements with impressive precision, allowing for strategic maneuvers and attacks from afar. 

However, this connection between the User and the Stand introduces a critical vulnerability: if the Stand sustains damage, the User will also suffer, creating a precarious balance between offense and defense. Many Long-Distance Stands lack the raw physical strength to compete with other types of Stands, which often necessitates a reliance on strategy rather than brute force. Users of these Stands typically exploit their extended range and precision to set ambushes, allowing them to strike at their opponents before they can react. 

While Long-Distance Stands excel in range, it does not inherently mean their abilities have extensive reach. Some Stands are capable of traveling vast distances from their Users yet only affect targets that are relatively nearby, demonstrating the complexity and variability of Stand abilities.

///Long Range Above

"Automatic Type": Automatic Stands are unique in that they do not operate under the direct command of their Users. Instead, they function autonomously, acting on pre-determined instructions or behaviors. Most Automatic Stands are, in essence, detached from their Users, which means that any damage inflicted upon the Stand does not affect the User, who may remain unaware of the Stand's condition or actions. Despite this detachment, there are various nuanced sub-categories of Automatic Stands that add depth to their functionality.

One such sub-type is the Far-Distance Autopilot Type (遠隔自動操縦型 Enkaku Jidō Sōjū-gata). These Stands can travel significant distances from their Users without losing any functionality or power. In addition to their inherent abilities, they often exhibit impressive physical traits, such as extraordinary durability and resilience. However, a limitation of most Far-Distance Autopilot Stands is that they adhere to simple instructions focused on a single datum, such as temperature or sound, and lack the capacity to adapt to changing circumstances or execute complex maneuvers.

Posthumous Stands (死んでるスタンド Shinderu Sutando) stand out in their ability to persist long after their User has passed away, granting them autonomy and the capability to act freely. Due to their nature as dead Stands, these entities operate independently of their User's will, making considerations of range and damage irrelevant.

Additionally, other Stands may demonstrate automatic abilities, requiring minimal input from the User to function. A Stand's power might be linked to a specific condition that is not dependent on the User's intent, rendering it semi-automatic. These Stands could possess sentience, acting on their own accord rather than following the User's commands. In such cases, the User may find themselves at the mercy of their own Stand, potentially becoming a victim of its powers.

///Automatic Type Above

"Range Irrelevant": A select few Stands are categorized as having range that plays a minimal role in determining how they function. This category includes certain Integrated Type (一体化型 Ittaika-gata) Stands, which may possess abilities that are effective regardless of distance, as well as Stands with space-time-related powers, where traditional notions of range simply do not apply. Among all the types discussed, this category is home to some of the most formidable and powerful Stands, showcasing abilities that transcend typical limitations and challenge the very fabric of reality.

///Range Irrelevant Above
